switches.title: Chat assignment
switches.intro: Four switches cover most workspaces: turn them on and you never have to create a rule.
switches.order: The order for a new chat: Contact Owner and Sticky Agent first, then your rules (if you add any), then Everyone else, then the waiting queue.
switches.readOnly: You can see these switches but not change them.
switches.loadFailed: The assignment settings could not be loaded.
switches.upgradeHint: Included in the Smart routing add-on or a higher plan.
switches.needsAuto: Used only while Auto Assignment is on.

auto.title: Auto Assignment
auto.body: New chats are shared evenly among agents who are accepting chats (not offline, busy or on leave). When every agent has reached their chat limit, new chats wait in the queue.
auto.limitHint: Set each agent's chat limit in their profile under <link>Team members</link>.
auto.off: Off: nothing is assigned automatically, not by a rule and not by the contact owner. Chats wait in the queue until someone claims them or a flow names a person.

sticky.title: Sticky Agent
sticky.body: A returning contact goes back to the agent who handled their last chat, as long as that agent is still an active member who can open the inbox (their online status is not checked). If the contact has an owner, the owner is tried first.
sticky.withWindow: How many days back the last agent counts is set under Advanced.

owner.title: Assign Chat to Contact Owner
owner.body: Chats from a known contact go to their contact owner first, so support stays consistent and personal. If the owner is on leave their delegate takes the chat; if there is no owner, the next step decides.
owner.wins: If Sticky Agent is also on, the contact owner still wins; the last agent is only the second choice.

claim.title: Assign Agent as Contact Owner
claim.body: When an agent claims a chat from the waiting queue and the contact has no owner yet, that agent becomes the contact owner. An existing owner is never changed.
claim.note: A chat given to an agent by a rule does not set the owner. With Keep open chats with the owner (under Advanced) a handoff does too.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.hint: Keeping chats in sync with the contact owner, the sticky window, reassign prompt and queue alerts.

sync.title: Keep open chats with the owner
sync.body: When a contact's owner changes, their open chats that were assigned automatically follow the new owner. A chat a person took is never moved. A handoff that assigns a chat also sets the owner when the contact has none.
sync.needsOwner: Turn on Assign Chat to Contact Owner first.

rules.title: Need more control? Add rules
rules.intro: Optional. Rules send particular chats (a channel, words in the message, a new contact...) to particular agents or teams. If the four switches are enough, you never have to create one.
rules.locked: Rules are part of the Smart routing add-on or a higher plan. You still have the waiting queue, claiming and manual assignment.
rules.pipelineTitle: How a new chat is assigned

pipeline.rulesBody: The first rule that matches and finds an available agent takes the chat.
pipeline.queueBody: If nobody is found, the chat waits in the Waiting tab until an agent claims it.

rules.never: Anything already assigned by a flow, a person or a handoff is never changed by the rules.
rules.empty: That is fine. Your switches above and Everyone else decide.
rules.loadFailed: The rules could not be loaded.
rules.neverMatchesHint: It has no condition and does not apply to every conversation. Edit it to fix that.
rules.shadowed: {count, plural, one {The rule below} other {The rules below}} “{blocker}” can never run unless nobody in “{blocker}” is available: {names}. “{blocker}” applies to every conversation and stops the check there. Move it down, or turn off “Stop when this rule matches” in it.

everyone.title: Everyone else
everyone.body: Takes every chat that no rule took. Choose who gets it.
everyone.notSet: Not set up yet: chats that no rule takes wait in the queue.
everyone.evenlyHint: Round robin or least busy over everyone who can open the inbox and is available: not offline, busy, on leave or at their chat limit.
everyone.queueHint: Nobody is assigned. The chat waits until an agent claims it.
everyone.confirmBody: Everyone else now gives chats to the agents or teams you chose. Distributing evenly replaces that choice.

where.title: Where this applies
where.applied1: When a new chat arrives (and when a customer reopens a finished one nobody holds).
where.applied2: When a Human handoff step is set to “Assignment rules”: the same list is checked then, using the contact, the channel and the customer's latest message, then Everyone else, then the waiting queue.
where.not1: A chat that a flow, a person or a handoff has already assigned.
where.not3: A Human handoff step that names a person (the rules are ignored) or a team (the team's own method is used).

try.title: Try it
try.body: Pick a contact, a channel and a sample message to see who would get the chat and why. Nothing is assigned, counted or sent.
try.noContact: No contact picked: the sample is a brand-new contact. Conditions on saved contact details cannot be checked without a real contact.
try.messagePlaceholder: e.g. I would like a refund

outcome.queue: Nobody is found: the chat waits in the queue.
outcome.off: Auto Assignment is switched off: nothing is assigned automatically.

why.sticky_off: Both switches are off, so this step is skipped.
why.no_contact: There is no contact to look up.
why.no_agent_found: No contact owner or last agent could take it.
why.last_handler: The agent of the contact's last chat takes it.
why.nobody_available: Matched, but nobody it points at is available.
why.team_queue: Matched; nobody was free, so it goes to the team's queue.
why.no_assignment_in_rule: Matched; this rule does not assign (it only does its other actions).
why.not_set: There is no active Everyone else rule, so chats nobody takes wait in the queue.

partWhy.no_saved_value: this contact does not have that saved, so it did not match
partWhy.not_same_kind: the contact is not of that kind
partWhy.channel_differs: this channel is not in the list
partWhy.no_word: none of the words are in the message
partWhy.language_differs: the language is different or unknown
partWhy.hours_differ: the time is not in that part of the day

try.tags: {count, plural, =0 {No tags saved.} one {# tag saved.} other {# tags saved.}}

skip.offline_busy_or_at_capacity: offline, busy or at their chat limit
skip.no_previous_handler_in_window: no earlier agent for this contact

try.outside: Pretend it is outside business hours
try.inside: Pretend it is inside business hours
try.clock: Business hours: use the clock now

form.whenSwitchHint: Off: this rule applies to every new conversation.
form.everyConversation: This rule applies to every new conversation.
form.kept: Your conditions are kept but ignored while this is off.

kind.title: New or returning contact
kind.hint: A contact is returning when it has an earlier chat, or was saved more than 10 minutes before this chat.

form.contactNote: Only matches contacts that already have this saved. A brand-new contact arrives with nothing saved except the stage “New”, so use New or returning contact for first-time customers.
form.everyoneElseNote: This is the Everyone else rule: it takes the chats no other rule took.
form.everyoneAgents: Everyone who can open the inbox
form.everyoneAgentsHint: Share the chats over all available agents instead of choosing them.
form.fallbackConditions: This rule has conditions saved from before, so it only takes the chats that match them. Turn on the switch below to review them, or remove them.
